name: Returned
description: Soulless, faceless undead who cross the Tartyx and wear golden masks.

description_citations.text: "Underworld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Samia asks about the Returned and eidolons, and Perisophia explains that they lack the capacity for an identity.
timeline.quote: It would appear that the Returned and the eidolons lack the capacity for an identity.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: The satyr tells of the Underworld's coinsmiths who mint ostraka from funerary masks, and explains that Erebos equalizes everyone and forbids a return except as one of the Returned.
timeline.quote: Erebos cares little for what you were in life. He only cares that you once existed.

citation.text: "The Path or the Horizon" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Posing as Udaen, Ashiok sends nightmare abominations to kill people at a peace meeting; the leonin annihilate Iretis, serving Phenax's plan, and Ashiok asks to be made invisible to the gods.
timeline.quote: The leonin retaliated by annihilating the Iretis' citizenry

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aphemia prowls the Despair Lands, using her song to command the Returned in raids on Meletian and Setessan settlements.
timeline.quote: using her unique song to control the Returned and command them to partake in raids on Meletian and Setessan settlements.

citation.text: "Asphodel", section "Inhabitants". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Silence of the Gods, Athreos becomes inactive, souls cannot be ferried, and Returned accumulate outside the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Athreos, like the other deities of Theros, became inactive.

citation.text: "Athreos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reveals themself as mastermind; Phenax claims Iretis for his Returned.
timeline.quote: Phenax would have the city to house his Returned

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Returned escape the underworld via the Path of Phenax, losing their identities, and gather in the necropoleis.
timeline.quote: The necropoleis of Asphodel and Odunos house the Returned, undead beings who have escaped the underworld at the cost of their identities.

citation.text: "Mortal Realm", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phenax assembles Returned, conquers Odunos, slaughters the population and binds their souls to the Black Oak.
timeline.quote: conquered Odunos, slaughtering the population and binding their souls to the Black Oak

citation.text: "Odunos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tymaret sends nightly raiding parties against minotaurs and human settlements near Akros.
timeline.quote: Tymaret regularly sends nightly raiding parties

citation.text: "Odunos", section "Geography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Akroan ranks fall into disorder and drown under the advancing Returned while Penthikos is cut off.
timeline.quote: he heard his shieldmates curse him as they died

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Other denizens of the Underworld replicate his escape, some assisted by Phenax, creating the Returned.
timeline.quote: other denizens of the Underworld replicated his escape

citation.text: "Returned", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phenax becomes the first to escape the Underworld through the Tartyx and ascends to godhood.
timeline.quote: Once a mortal soul, Phenax became the first to escape the Underworld by journeying through the Tartyx River.

citation.text: "Underworld", section "Locations inside the Underworld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: He helps the dead pass into the Underworld, from which the Returned escaped.
relations.quote: they pass into the Underworld with the aid of the god Athreos, the River Guide.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

relations.note: Each Returned has a severed eidolon, and they are never reunited.
relations.quote: The Returned and its severed eidolon are never reunited, nor are they aware of one another's existence.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

relations.note: She wanders Asphodel among the Returned who rejected the Underworld.
relations.quote: we left her to wander Asphodel with the others who rejected the Underworld.

citation.text: "Dance of the Flitterstep" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Feb 2014.

relations.quote: Phenax also serves as protector and patron of the Returned

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Influence and Goals". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Dead people who escaped the Underworld and lost all identity, becoming faceless.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.
